layout.name: levelFilename
layout.title: Level Filename
layout.tooltip: Filename of the level that this tile leads to.

layout.name: once
layout.title: No immediate respawn
layout.tooltip: If enabled, the enemy won't come back immediately once the map refreshes.

layout.name: respawntime
layout.title: Respawn Timer
layout.tooltip: How many times must the map be loaded before the enemy respawns if no immediate respawn is set to true. Setting it to 0 makes the enemy unable to respawn

layout.name: steps
layout.title: Enemy Steps
layout.tooltip: How many steps will the enemy take before stopping.

layout.name: dontsavepos
layout.title: Don't save position
layout.tooltip: If enabled, the enemy won't have its position saved between levels.

layout.name: direction
layout.title: Starting Direction (Movers)
layout.tooltip: The starting direction of the enemy (only applies to enemies with the ismover or followredirectors config)
